thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT (P2) — KV cache pressure in eu-west-2 causing elevated 5xx on /v1/infer. Alert triggered, spike started ~03:10UTC. Link: <https://observability.redwood/alerts/INC-3265|INC-3265>
Maya: Heads up — I'm primary and need to hand off. Flight lands in ~45m, can stay +20m max. @everyone, need somebody to take primary for the surge or coordinate a partial handoff.
Owen: I can take primary for a ~2h window if Samir can't. I'm currently shadowing and available now. :wave:
Samir: I can take primary but I'm in a weekly until 03:40UTC. Can take at 03:45UTC if Maya extends by 15m.
Maya: I can extend 20m. Quick mitigation notes in the runbook — scale pool + restart rt-cache workers, enable fallback to quantized model if errors persist. Runbook: <https://go/runbooks/oncall/kv-cache-pressure|KV cache pressure runbook>.
Jess: Question — do we want to canary-fallback to the quantized variant? We saw fewer 5xx on that path during last test.
Lina: Yes + add TTL pruning on prefix-KV. Short script below. Also watch for increased latency after fallback.
Maya: Pasting commands I'm about to run if nobody takes primary immediately:
```bash
# scale dedicated inference pool in eu-west-2
rctl scale pool eu-west-2-infer-pool --replicas +2

# restart real-time cache workers
kubectl -n infra rollout restart deployment/rt-cache-workers

# set routing fallback to quantized variant (canary)
redwoodctl fallback set --route /v1/infer --model redwood/ggml-quant-v1
```
deploy-bot: Deploy queued: rollback-candidate-2026-03-14 is currently blocked due to incident.
Maya: Also tail these logs for the common eviction error: `tail -n 200 /var/log/infer/05-errors.log` — look for "KV eviction exceeded soft_limit" entries.
Owen: I'll take primary now. @Samir stay secondary for escalation? Who will own customer comms?
Samir: I'll remain secondary and start the incident doc. Jess, can you own customer comms? I'll help with timeline and postmortem later.
Jess: I got customer comms. Drafting a short note in #support -> will ping legal + success for signoff. ETA 10m for initial outbound. :thumbsup:
Owen: Running restart now and scaling pool. Pasting actions I'm executing:
```bash
rctl scale pool eu-west-2-infer-pool --replicas +2 && \
kubectl -n infra rollout restart deployment/rt-cache-workers && \
redwoodctl metrics watch --filter "route:/v1/infer,metric:5xx_rate" --window 5m
```
Owen: restart triggered. Watching logs for `worker_recover` and `kv_rehydrate` messages.
Maya: handoff checklist I left: PD ack, runbook link, phone on, and annotate rotation calendar with swap details. Phone: +1-xxx-xxx-xxxx (on-call reachable).
incident-bot: PagerDuty acknowledged by Owen.
Samir: Monitoring metrics — 5xx peaked ~8% at 03:12UTC, after scale it's trending down to ~2.3% (last 3m). Latency up ~30ms p50.
Owen: Seeing worker_recover entries in logs, `kv_rehydrate` completed on 3/5 nodes. Errors decreasing.
Jess: Sent initial customer note to impacted tenants with workaround and ETA ~1h. Shared draft in #support for review. Link: <https://support.redwood/threads/INC-3265-comms|support thread>.
Lina: If 5xx goes back above 5%, we should flip route to backup-quant immediately: `redwoodctl routing set --route /v1/infer --variant backup-quant` — that avoids cache path.
Maya: Thanks — I'm going offline in a few. If things need me urgently ping mobile and escalate. Otherwise Owen has primary.
Samir: Minor ops note: annotate the rotation calendar and add a short reason: "emergency swap due to KV pressure — Owen primary from 03:18UTC". I'll create the incident doc skeleton and link logs.
deploy-bot: CI job 4921 blocked by incident flag; will auto-resume when incident=resolved.
incident-bot: Incident updated: status=mitigating, severity=P2, updates=scale+restart+fallback-ready.
Owen: Confirming primary takeover at 03:18UTC. Continuing to monitor; will escalate to SRE execs if 5xx > 4% for 10m.
Jess: Customer comms live. Will post follow-ups as we have ETA changes.
Lina: Added TTL pruning script to runbook and pushed a short PR to infra-runbooks.
Maya: Appreciate the pick-up. Leaving final note: check KMS connectivity if any anomalies — earlier we saw a flurry of KMS timeouts before the KV eviction.
Samir: Copy. Will include KMS check in postmortem actions.
incident-bot: Reminder: please add incident tag `oncall-swap` to rotation calendar and link incident doc.
Owen: All good for now — continuing to monitor. If we drop below 1% 5xx for 15m I'll start a controlled demobilization.
Jess: thx team, will update customers after the 15m stable window. :rocket:
